kind: exploratory (探索値); quality runs are deterministic, 1 run each; 1080p; warmup 60 + 240 frames unless noted; no sky (leak rooms with sky, 60 frames); DDGI object/floor comparisons with warmup 2400
machine: one development machine (AMD Radeon 8060S APU); the machine was never idle: another process used about 1.3 CPU cores and a second ~0.5-1 core during all timings (user could not free it, asked twice by AskUserQuestion)

default.change: cascade rays skip the dynamic layer within one level-0 voxel (0.2 m) of the probe (a probe registered by an object's pixels saw that object's own surface); splat window 144 voxels (values identical, cheaper)

allocatedMiB.note: the dynamic layer holds 13 words per voxel (3 albedo words, written only by obj configs)

option_obj: config token obj (RC and ddgi-...): the dynamic layer splats area x albedo; dynInject adds albedo / pi x irradiance (RC: previous frame's bounce volume, DDGI: its probes) per voxel, weighted over the six face areas; the bounce volume's irradiance rays read the dynamic layer (cone of one of 16 rays). Not in the default: +0.15 ms GI and the budget could not be judged on an idle machine

timingStart_busy.scene: sponza-dynobj-n64-deform-bwave, sky, default config, native then browser alternated

O1_objectPixelBias.rule: |bias| <= half of the current value (current = after phase 29: pose 0 -21.85 % pixel / -22.1 % 8x8, pose 100 -14.9 % / -16.2 %); both readings must pass: pose 0 <= 10.9 %, pose 100 <= 7.45 %

O2_floorNearObjects.rule: ratio to the reference 0.7-1.4 at all 4 rectangles (contact, front shade, under the ring, far shade)

O3_budget.rule: 3 runs <= 4.0 ms static and moving on an idle machine, <= 128 MB

O4_noRegression.rule: static flicker 0, response 4/2, lag <= 2 %, sponza-dynobj jump <= 1.2 x 0.0055, errors and leak <= 1.1 x, toon band changes not more than before

tried.sunVisibility2points: vox.sun 0.24-0.27 -> 0.17-0.18 ms, cut-scene jump 0.0158 -> 0.0173, but toon band 1.171 -> 1.331 %: rejected
tried.voxSunMergedIntoResolveAttr: same cost (0.28-0.30 vs 0.063 + 0.23 ms), not bit-identical: rejected
